description: US Treasury yields and inflation data: daily Treasury par yield curve (1-month to 30-year) plus BLS CPI, core CPI, unemployment rate and nonfarm payrolls for the last 13 months with year-over-year change. Use when a finance agent needs current US interest rates, inflation or jobs data. Sources: US Treasury, BLS (public). Signed receipt. Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base or XRP on XRPL). The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict. Example arguments: {"series":"treasury,cpi"}.
name: us_rates_macro

outputSchema.description: Paid result: { data, receipt }. Unpaid calls return an x402 PaymentRequired object instead (isError: true).

data.description: US Treasury par yield curve and BLS CPI, core CPI, unemployment and payrolls series

provenance.description: The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict.

receipt.description: Ed25519-signed, hash-chained receipt; verify free with the verify_receipt tool or POST /v1/verify-receipt. New receipts carry a signed `evidence` object: service_version, data_timestamp, validation, terms_version, terms_hash, provenance_hash.

title: US Treasury Yields and CPI
